hooks.name: Steering-First Implementation Guard
hooks.description: Before any implementation, forces the AI to check steering files and specs for applicable constraints, preventing wasted tokens on non-compliant code that would need to be rewritten.

action.prompt: Before implementing: 1) Which steering rules apply to this change? (Check security.md for privacy constraints, architecture.md for layer rules) 2) Does this align with specs/requirements.md? 3) Will this pass the existing hooks (no secrets, no plaintext logging, no localStorage)? Plan compliance BEFORE writing code to avoid rewrites.
